summary.text: Bob Niemeyer is the Republican candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 25, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Ben Bowman (D).
Niemeyer is a self-employed mechanical engineer who, according to Ballotpedia, has run in several earlier elections, including for the Oregon House in 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Bob Niemeyer is the son of a dentist and grew up in Silverton, Oregon.
He served in the U.S. Navy from 1977 to 1978, graduated from Silverton Union High School in 1973, and earned a B.S. in mechanical engineering from Oregon State University in 1978.
He is a licensed professional mechanical engineer and founded his own engineering company.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a self-employed mechanical engineer who has worked out of Tigard for more than 30 years in product development, and said he holds more than thirty patents.
Niemeyer ran in the 2014 Republican primary for Oregon's 1st Congressional District and lost to Jason Yates.
He was also one of five candidates in the 2016 Republican primary for governor, which Bud Pierce won.
He lost Oregon House general elections in District 35 to Margaret Doherty in 2018 and to Dacia Grayber in 2020, and in District 25 to Ben Bowman in 2022 and 2024.
In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Niemeyer listed cutting the size of government before raising taxes and government obeying the Constitution among his priorities.
